sourceBuiltHostDistribution.scope: Ubuntu host-only distribution; not an Android/Bionic package input

blockers.evidence: The pinned Termux reference recipe is gradle 1:9.8.1 and installs the prebuilt gradle-9.8.1-bin.zip (SHA-256 dce76f55f8e251a3a1f130eb120f30b3d271de2b76c9b0729d316b5a1b6dc01f). The repository has no Gradle package-builder kit or source-grounded Gradle package recipe. The separate Gradle 9.8.2 source build produces only a host distribution and is not a replacement package recipe/version by implication.

The verified Gradle 9.8.2 source archive declares net.rubygrapefruit:native-platform:0.22-milestone-29 in gradle/dependency-management/distribution.versions.toml and uses it as a runtime API dependency in platforms/core-runtime/native/build.gradle.kts. The official gradle/verification-metadata.xml contains 88 verified components and 98 verified artifacts but no native-platform component or artifact checksum. The Gradle source archive contains Gradle's Java integration code, not the separate native-platform native-library source project. The source-built distribution contains Linux/AArch64 native-platform JARs with glibc-linked .so payloads; the native-platform binary JARs inspected contain no embedded license/notice files. The dependency's exact artifact/source hashes, license notices and a Bionic-compatible native build are therefore not established by this source-build evidence.
references: official Gradle 9.8.2 source archive: gradle-9.8.2/gradle/dependency-management/distribution.versions.toml (nativePlatform, lines 42 and 149)

blockers.evidence: The ARM64 fallback workflow removes Linux/AArch64 .so ZIP entries only from copied native-platform JARs for a bounded smoke test on Ubuntu ARM64 with glibc and Temurin JDK 17. It verifies the original distribution remains unchanged. The removal is not part of a Gradle package recipe or reproducible package diff, and the smoke does not demonstrate that all required Gradle operations work without native-platform or that Android/Bionic works. Whether every required operation can safely fall back without the native library remains unproven; the native-platform loader has native-library initialization paths.
blockers.smokeScope: ARM64 Linux with glibc only; not Android/Bionic

blockers.evidence: The existing signed test-only aggregate is locked to an 80-package base plus exactly two source-built companions and exact existing roots. Its builder enforces packageCount=82 and exactly those two new package identities. Gradle is not one of the locked 13 roots. Adding Gradle to that aggregate would violate its current package-set contract; the cohort remains unchanged.

requiredInputsBeforeReconsideration: A pinned, source/licence-audited native-platform dependency with verified artifact hashes and either a source-built Bionic-compatible native implementation or a documented, tested Gradle runtime mode that does not require the native library.

A version-reconciled, reproducible Gradle package recipe that records every patch/removal, exact source and dependency inputs, payload paths, license notices, ELF/DT_NEEDED results, and package dependencies.
A separate test-only signed feed and exact APT simulation that preserve the existing 82-package cohort unchanged unless a specific dependency addition is justified.
ARM64 Android/Bionic device proof for native loading, file watching on/off, daemon/process lifecycle, and a real project build before any qualification claim.
